# MongoDB Extension for Hibernate ORM - (current)

> The MongoDB Extension for Hibernate ORM lets you map Java classes to MongoDB data and interact with it using Hibernate ORM's data mapping and querying capabilities.

- [Feature Compatibility](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/languages/java/mongodb-hibernate/current/feature-compatibility.md)
- [Get Started with the Hibernate ORM Extension](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/languages/java/mongodb-hibernate/current/get-started.md): Learn how to create a Hibernate app that connects to a MongoDB deployment
- [MongoDB Extension for Hibernate ORM](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/languages/java/mongodb-hibernate/current/index.md)
- [Interact with Data](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/languages/java/mongodb-hibernate/current/interact-data.md): Learn how to use Hibernate ORM extension to interact with MongoDB data.
- [Perform CRUD Operations](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/languages/java/mongodb-hibernate/current/interact-data/crud.md)
- [Perform Native Database Queries](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/languages/java/mongodb-hibernate/current/interact-data/native-queries.md)
- [Specify a Query](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/languages/java/mongodb-hibernate/current/interact-data/specify-a-query.md)
- [Transactions and Sessions](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/languages/java/mongodb-hibernate/current/interact-data/transactions.md)
- [Report Issues and Request Help](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/languages/java/mongodb-hibernate/current/issues-and-help.md)
- [Model Your Data](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/languages/java/mongodb-hibernate/current/model-data.md): Learn how to use the Hibernate ORM extension to model MongoDB data.
- [Create Entities to Represent Collections](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/languages/java/mongodb-hibernate/current/model-data/entities.md)
